name: 소프트웨어 핑거프린트 분석
description: Deep 분석 of software signatures, version 패턴, and encoding fingerprints 식별하기 위해 specific AI generation tools, camera manufacturers, and image processing pipelines.
mechanism:
The software fingerprint 분석 operates on three 감지 layers:

1. **AI Tool Signature Matching**: Matches 메타데이터 values against a comprehensive database of 25+ AI tool signatures including Stable Diffusion (A1111, ComfyUI, InvokeAI), DALL-E, Midjourney, Leonardo.AI, and others. 확인합니다 CreatorTool, Software, ProcessingSoftware fields.

2. **Camera Manufacturer Identification**: Cross-references Make/Model/Software fields against known camera manufacturer databases (Canon, Nikon, Sony, Fujifilm, Panasonic, Olympus, Apple, Samsung, Google Pixel).

3. **Encoding Library Detection**: 식별합니다 the image encoding library from JPEG/PNG headers and 메타데이터 (libjpeg, MozJPEG, Pillow/PIL, OpenCV, ImageMagick). AI tools typically use Python-based libraries (Pillow, OpenCV) while cameras use proprietary encoders.

4. **Version Pattern Analysis**: Validates software version strings against known 패턴 감지하기 위해 fabricated 메타데이터.
parameters:
AI tools: 25+ signatures (Stable Diffusion, DALL-E 2/3, Midjourney v5/v6, ComfyUI, InvokeAI, Leonardo.AI, Firefly, Bing Image Creator, etc.)
Camera brands: Canon, Nikon, Sony, Fujifilm, Panasonic, Apple, Samsung, Google
Encoding libraries: libjpeg, MozJPEG, Pillow, OpenCV, ImageMagick, libpng
Checked fields: CreatorTool, Software, ProcessingSoftware, Make, Model
accuracy: Very 높음 - 90-95% when software signatures are present in 메타데이터. Accuracy depends on 메타데이터 not being stripped.
source: Stable Diffusion GitHub, OpenAI API, Midjourney Docs
useCase: Primary identification method for determining exactly 는 tool created an image. Critical for content moderation platforms, journalism fact-checking, and 포렌식 investigations where knowing the specific AI tool is important.
strengths:
• 사용된 정확한 AI 도구와 버전 식별
• 서명 존재 시 매우 높은 정확도
• 카메라 제조사 식별로 실제 사진 검증
• 인코딩 라이브러리 감지
• 지속적으로 업데이트되는 데이터베이스
limitations:
• 메타데이터가 쉽게 제거될 수 있음
• 소셜 미디어가 소프트웨어 메타데이터 삭제
• 일부 AI가 카메라 메타데이터를 모방
• 새 AI 도구가 데이터베이스에 없을 수 있음
• 메타데이터 제거 시 AI 감지 불가

references.title: Yu, N. et al. (2019). Attributing Fake Images to GANs: Learning and Analyzing GAN Fingerprints. ICCV.
